book.energizedpower.page.charger_uncharg: The advanced version of the Charger and the Uncharger have 3 slots and the elite versions have 7 slots.
book.energizedpower.page.coolant_cell: Coolant Cells are used to cool the most powerful machines.
book.energizedpower.page.crystallized_la: Crystallized Lapis Lazuli is the key component in the best machines.
book.energizedpower.page.energized_alloy: The Energized Alloy Ingot is the most powerful alloy in Energized Power.
book.energizedpower.page.energizing_spee: Energizing Speed upgrades make the Energizer faster but keep the total energy consumption the same.
Energy consumption per tick will be increased at the same rate as the speed is increased.
If higher tiers of the Energizing Speed Upgrades are used, Energy Capacity Upgrades must be installed to keep the Energizer operational.
book.energizedpower.page.energy_producti: Energy Production Upgrades increase the energy production.
book.energizedpower.page.fluid_freezer.1: The Fluid Freezer produces Ice and Snow from Water.
book.energizedpower.page.fluid_freezer.2: Fluids must be inserted with a pipe.
book.energizedpower.page.io_configuratio: Most machines support Item/Fluid IO configuration.
Every machine has one ore more predefined slot groups per slot type (Item, Fluid).
Any slot within a slot group can be in one of the following modes:
Input (blue)
Output (orange)
Input/Output (green)
Any slot without highlighting is not part of this slot group.
To change the configuration of a side the slot type must be selected in the top left-hand corner in the IO Configuration view.
Afterwards one of the 6 side buttons can be used to select a slot group.
The slots from the currently configured slot group are highlighted when hovering above the side button.
Clicking the button will go to the next slot group. SHIFT + clicking the button will go to the previous slot group.
The color of the button is
Input (blue)
when all slots of the selected slot group are inputs
Output (orange)
when all slots of the selected slot group are outputs
Input/Output (green)
when the selected slot groups has input and output slots
Not configured (light gray)
when IO for the selected slot type is disabled
book.energizedpower.page.item_ejector_up: Item Ejector Upgrades will allow machines to automatically push items into the first valid output.
Priority from highest to lowest: Down, Up, North, South, West, East.
book.energizedpower.page.item_pulling_up: Item Pulling Upgrades will allow machines to automatically pull items from the first valid input.
Priority from highest to lowest: Down, Up, North, South, West, East.
book.energizedpower.page.liquid_xp.1: Liquid XP is produced by machines using the XP Extraction upgrade and the XP Drain.
book.energizedpower.page.liquid_xp.2: It can be stored in Fluid Tanks and in XP Storages.
book.energizedpower.page.liquid_xp.3: Liquid XP can be transferred from/to players with XP Storages.
book.energizedpower.page.machine_configu: The Machine Configurator can be used to copy Redstone/Comparator mode config and IO Configuration from one machine to another.
There are five machine frames: Basic, Hardened, Advanced, Reinforced Advanced, and Elite.
book.energizedpower.page.powered_furnace: The advanced version of the Powered Furnace has 3 input/output slot pairs and the elite version has 7 input/output slot pairs.
book.energizedpower.page.solar_cells.2: There are four solar cells: Basic, Advanced, Reinforced Advanced, and Elite
book.energizedpower.page.superconductor: Superconductors are used for the most efficient transmission of electricity.
book.energizedpower.page.time_controller: It can be automated with redstone. Signal Strength 1 will set the time of the day to 0 ticks and 15 will set the time of the day to 14/15 of the amount of ticks in a day.
It can also be automated with computers from CCTweaked.
book.energizedpower.page.transformers.4: There are five tiers of transformers: LV, MV, HV, EHV, and UHV.
book.energizedpower.page.weather_control: It can be automated with redstone - signal strengths: (15: clear, 14: rain, 13: thunder, 1 - 12 (only if the Duration Upgrade Module (Tier VI) is installed): reset selected weather).
It can also be automated with computers from CCTweaked.
book.energizedpower.page.xp_drain.1: The XP Drain drains XP from players and XP orbs and converts them into Liquid XP.
book.energizedpower.page.xp_extraction_u: XP Extraction Upgrades enable XP yield for machines like the Powered Furnace.
XP points are collected in an internal fluid tank. The machine will not stop if the tank is full, but additional XP will vanish.
You can connect the machine via Fluid Pipes to an XP Storage to insert XP into the player inventory.
book.energizedpower.page.xp_storages.1: XP Storages can store XP very efficiently and can be used to transfer Liquid XP from/to players.
book.energizedpower.page.xp_storages.2: There are five tiers of XP Storages: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, and Giant
